related.title: 國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「每個密封筒的熱負載」與「屏蔽厚度與半值層」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Heat load of one canister" and "Shield thickness and half-value layers" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用過燃料的乾式貯存：密封鋼筒、自然對流、屏蔽、傾倒穩定性與老化管理；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程則以BWR-6 與馬克三型圍阻體：抑壓池、用過燃料池容量、乾式貯存與二十五年除役為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dry storage of spent fuel: sealed canisters, natural convection, shielding, tip-over stability and ageing management; Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning centres on BWR-6 with Mark III containment: suppression pool, spent-fuel pool capacity, dry storage and a twenty-five-year decommissioning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「半衰期與活度衰減」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「自然對流的風量」的模型移到國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「乾式貯存護箱的數量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Air flow by natural convection" to Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The number of dry-storage casks", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「每個密封筒的熱負載」與「屏蔽厚度與半值層」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Heat load of one canister" and "Shield thickness and half-value layers" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning must be respecified.

related.title: 安克羅深層地質處置場
related.transfer: 可遷移「每個密封筒的熱負載」與「屏蔽厚度與半值層」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；安克羅深層地質處置場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Heat load of one canister" and "Shield thickness and half-value layers" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Onkalo Deep Geological Repository must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦用過燃料的乾式貯存：密封鋼筒、自然對流、屏蔽、傾倒穩定性與老化管理；安克羅深層地質處置場則以世界第一座用過核燃料深層地質處置場：銅罐、膨潤土與結晶岩的多重障壁為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dry storage of spent fuel: sealed canisters, natural convection, shielding, tip-over stability and ageing management; Onkalo Deep Geological Repository centres on the world's first deep geological repository for spent fuel: multiple barriers of copper canister, bentonite and crystalline rock, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「半衰期與活度衰減」與「半衰期與活度衰減」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「自然對流的風量」的模型移到安克羅深層地質處置場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「地下水流速與傳輸時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Half-life and decay of activity" and "Half-life and decay of activity".
Move the model of "Air flow by natural convection" to Onkalo Deep Geological Repository, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Groundwater velocity and travel time", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「每個密封筒的熱負載」與「屏蔽厚度與半值層」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；安克羅深層地質處置場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Heat load of one canister" and "Shield thickness and half-value layers" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Onkalo Deep Geological Repository must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 乾式貯存護箱與獨立貯存設施
history.titleEn: Dry Cask Storage and Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installations
history.text: 1986 年美國首座乾式貯存設施啟用；2011 年福島第一的乾式護箱經歷海嘯；2013 年臺灣核一廠乾貯設施完成熱測試前的整備；2020 年美國多座電廠取得 40 年後的延長執照。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1986: The first US dry storage installation entered service. 2011: Dry casks at Fukushima Daiichi went through the tsunami. 2013: Taiwan's Chinshan dry store completed preparation for hot testing. 2020: Several US plants held renewed licences beyond 40 years. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
